checks.detail: Full phase acceptance remains unassessed. Independent ordinary input established retained training, village-to-bridge traversal, lightning damage and reward restoration. The original append_array error did not recur; the final log was read from that same runtime generation after the last lightning callback, before restart. Correction receipts now confirm the exact candidate workspace and an agent-authored diagnostic following the occlusion observation, with source_camera_unchanged=true. A fresh correction-generation final runtime log contains only startup stdout. Outstanding requirements include invalid/freed-target runtime coverage, adjacent fire practice, one tracker matrix frame, complete graybox/collision retirement review, visual comparison, performance and low-setting observations. Editor resource errors and mesh diagnostics remain unresolved.

required_criteria.requirement: 用户指定 Forest-Godot4 地图替换，按 operator-environment.md 接入已组装 Terrain3D 地形、草木、河流与桥；普通第三人称操作能从保留的村庄走入自然环境。完整删除被替换区域的旧地面、灰盒及其生成/碰撞路径，避免地板叠加。保留 village 人物动画/武器绑定、NPC、剑弓取得/训练、奖励和存档；验证出生点、镜头、通行、普通战斗和保存重启。无第三方示例角色/调试 UI，画面与官方示例及 PRD 参考图对比，并实测导入、启动、帧耗与设置低档。由 Developer 实现并按仓库绑定身份提交，Tester 独立当前候选验证。环境阶段通过不替代原 PRD R01–R24、五个里程碑和最终验收。

risk_note.summary: A restored save may contain defeated enemies, while unmatched or unsettled tracker snapshots may again leave acceptance insufficiently evidenced.
risk_note.validation: Use an explicitly isolated test session with an ordinarily acquired lightning ability and living enemy; capture the same runtime generation's final log. Pair tracker frames with viewport/scale/content snapshots after layout settles.
risk_note.why_now: The runtime failure blocks a declared initial-element combat path, and tracker coverage has stalled across repeated treatments.

task_requirements.requirement: Using ordinary controls, lightning hits a living bridge enemy with authoritative HP loss and feedback; dead, invalid, obstructed and absent targets are rejected, and the same runtime branch finishes without equivalent candidate-owned errors.

Ordinary journal, collapse and settings actions reach genuine short and wrapped objectives; the read-only HUD observation exposes viewport, text scale, tracked text, visibility, collapse state and geometry without changing progression or release UI.
